The fine print

Timeline

2–3 weeks (Shopify) or 4–5 weeks (Squarespace) from deposit and content. It moves as fast as your feedback does.

Revisions

Unlimited within the project. If we pause more than 30 days waiting on feedback, we restart on the next open schedule.

Ownership

At launch you own the site, the theme, and every brand asset made for it. Prancer may show the work in its portfolio.

Support

60 days after launch for questions, fixes, and small updates. A rebrand or major redesign is a new project.

Not included

A new logo or full identity system, photo or video shoots, and platform or domain fees.
